idea-plugin.name: Prelo Reports
idea-plugin.description:
Designer and live preview for Prelo reports (*.report.json), a lightweight JasperReports alternative for Java.
  • Visual designer: drag blocks and fields onto the layout and edit properties in a side panel.
  • Split editor: JSON on the left, PDF pages on the right, updated as you type.
  • Fields from a project class (dataClass): record, POJO, Lombok or Kotlin.
  • Completion for ${field} and warnings for unknown fields, scoped to tables and lists.
  • JSON completion and validation from the bundled schema.
  • Sample data generated from fields or read from name.sample.json.
  • Export PDF, HTML, XLSX and CSV from the preview.
  • JasperReports migration: right-click a .jrxml file (or folder) to convert it.

The user interface is currently in Portuguese (pt-BR).
